claim_summary: Reconstructed the signed real-stable ambient-hole polynomial and derived the all-size coefficient-one square-root exchange from an odd-degree Hurwitz endpoint inequality.
Reconstructed the aggregate hole-capacity transfer with D0=10^8(n+1)^4, conditional on balanced two-hole ratios.

Proved an exact-balance existence lemma: for positive two-hole ratios, maximizing sum y_i under y_i+y_j<=-log g_ij and applying F -> DFD gives row maxima exactly 1 while preserving the full-basis law. Exact ratio acquisition remains unimplemented.

Proved the hard directed-cycle pair-label fiber has exactly two alternating states at Hamming distance q, ruling out a sampler confined to sub-q local moves; this does not rule out a positive-auxiliary augmented chain.
status: INITIAL_FROZEN; general counting, exact/approximate balanced-ratio acquisition, and the microscopic two-replica Poincare kernel remain open
